task:
Add Slack incoming-webhook support to rightnow-ai's webhook system.

Create packages/core/src/webhooks/slack.ts exporting SLACK_URL_MASK = "https://hooks.slack.com/services/***", isSlackUrl(url) -> boolean (https, exact host hooks.slack.com, path starting /services/, no userinfo, false on parse errors) and slackText(payload: Record<string, unknown>) -> string. slackText produces mrkdwn lines: ":fire: Interested reply from <email> (<company>)", ":calendar: Meeting requested by ...", ":speech_balloon: Reply from ...", ":warning: Mailbox problem: <account> (<reason>)", ":hourglass_flowing_sand: Daily quota reached: <account> on <campaign>", else "<event_type>: <who or account or workspace>". Append " <url|Open in inbox>" for an http(s) unibox_url and a newline "> snippet" (max 200 characters) for reply_text_snippet; HTML-escape interpolated values.

Extend webhookInput in packages/core/src/webhooks/service.ts with format "json" | "slack" (default json). createWebhook rejects a non-Slack URL with invalid_slack_url and Slack headers with headers_not_allowed, stores SLACK_URL_MASK in url, the encrypted real URL in a new urlEnc column and the format; API payloads omit urlEnc. updateWebhook rejects format changes with format_fixed, validates a changed Slack URL, and does not rewrite url for Slack. Add urlEnc to the Webhook model and to ENCRYPTED_COLUMNS in packages/core/src/crypto.ts. In packages/core/src/webhooks/deliver.ts, postWebhook sends {"text": slackText(JSON.parse(body))} for Slack and decrypts urlEnc as the target. Include an ACCOUNT_ERROR reason from event meta in buildPayload.

Add or update tests for the new behavior.
test_command: npm run db:generate && npx vitest run packages/core/test/rotate.test.ts packages/core/test/webhooks-slack.test.ts --reporter=junit --outputFile=.bench-junit/hidden.xml
suite_command: npm run db:generate && npx vitest run packages/core --reporter=junit --outputFile=.bench-junit/suite.xml
